briefings.title: Perplexity CEO and Founder Aravind Srinivas at Silicon Valley & The World | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas revealed that the company just crossed $1 billion in annual run rate (ARR) with 5x lower burn than its major IPO-bound competitor, driven by a capital-efficient, model-neutral "agent orchestration" strategy.

briefings.title: Silicon Valley & The World: Brad Gerstner, Founder & CEO, Altimeter Capital | Semafor
briefings.tldr: Altimeter Capital CEO Brad Gerstner urged the Nvidia board to resist political pressure and take its time investigating CEO Jensen Huang, revealed Altimeter requested a firm-record $5 billion allocation in Anthropic's 10–20x oversubscribed IPO, and detailed how universal "Trump Accounts" are catalyzing tens of billions of dollars in direct philanthropy from tech leaders like Elon Musk and Michael Dell.

briefings.title: Social Media Broke The Internet. Can Reddit Save It? | Mixed Signals
briefings.tldr: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman outlines the platform’s transformation from a niche, hands-off forum into a major public company, detailing its commercial battles with AI firms, its firm stance against the "influencer economy," and why maintaining pseudonymity is crucial to preserving human authenticity on the modern internet.
